title: The Unexpected Recipe
author: Ansel Whitlock
blurb: Wren Galloway, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
